name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to est
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(2.148)|0> and RY(2.537)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((2.148-2.537)/2). The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
